candidate.title: Ribo-Seq/ART-Seq/GTI-Seq
candidate.scope: Assigned Illumina grouped footprint-to-cDNA schematic: one unbranched route from ribosome-bound RNA through RNase digestion, RNA extraction, rRNA depletion, a second RNA extraction, and reverse transcription to cDNA. Ribo-Seq and ART-Seq are catalogue aliases; GTI-Seq is a distinct initiation-focused member using the depicted family-level material interface. The left ribosome/RNA emblem and the input caption Ribosome are descriptive, not extra transformations. The matching collection page 47 explicitly captions its related drawing Ribo-Seq/ARTseq and therefore corroborates those names without independently establishing GTI-Seq scope. The drawing ends at cDNA; adapters, amplification, sequencing, and computational analysis are outside the graph. The final cDNA is the depicted precursor/carrier for a downstream footprint DNA sequencing library, not evidence that every sequencing-ready library feature is already present. No claim of identical complete protocols or historical development is made.

operations.label: RNase digestion
operations.description: Digest exposed RNA in ribosome-bound material, leaving a short ribosome-protected RNA fragment on the ribosome. The yellow icon denotes the nuclease acting on the material, not a separately flowing biological product.
operations.mechanism: Ribosome protection makes an RNA segment survive nuclease digestion.
operations.information_effect: Selects footprints of ribosome occupancy rather than preserving full-length transcript structure; the surviving RNA sequence carries the positional information.

evidence.quote: The position of a translating ribosome can be precisely determined by using the fact that a ribosome protects a discrete footprint [∼30 nucleotides (nt)] on its mRNA template from nuclease digestion (12).

operations.label: RNA extraction
operations.description: Recover RNA from the digested ribosome material. The output is free RNA, including the protected target RNA and rRNA, rather than an intact ribosome complex.
operations.information_effect: Ribosome attachment is lost, while the protected RNA fragment retains the footprint sequence.

operations.label: rRNA depletion
operations.description: Reduce the rRNA component of the extracted RNA mixture while retaining target RNA; the drawing fades the rRNA icon. No depletion chemistry or separate collected rRNA branch is specified.
operations.information_effect: Enriches the preparation for target footprint RNA relative to ribosomal RNA contamination; it does not prove all retained RNA is a footprint.

operations.label: RNA extraction
operations.description: Recover the RNA remaining after rRNA depletion, yielding the isolated short purple RNA drawn as input to reverse transcription. This is a distinct local extraction with a different input history from the first extraction.
operations.information_effect: Retains the footprint RNA as the template for DNA copying; no additional sequence selection is specified.

operations.label: Reverse transcription
operations.description: Copy recovered RNA into cDNA. The paired purple and black lines illustrate RNA-to-DNA copying and the outgoing arrow ends at the black cDNA product. This broad conversion includes the depicted intermediate without assigning an unlabelled RNA-removal chemistry.
operations.mechanism: Reverse transcription produces DNA complementary to the RNA template.
operations.information_effect: Transfers footprint sequence information from RNA to DNA. Downstream sequencing, described in text but not drawn, can identify protected transcript regions and count their representation in the DNA library. General Ribo-Seq represents ribosome occupancy across translated regions; GTI-Seq interprets initiation-enriched footprints as evidence for translation initiation positions, not as a direct measurement of initiation rate.

method_scopes.rationale: All five operations describe the assigned catalogue-level ribosome profiling workflow. They are not asserted to reproduce every step of the 2009 yeast implementation. In particular, the diagram explicitly includes rRNA depletion, whereas the original paper reports substantial rRNA contamination and suggests future subtractive removal. Ribosome footprint DNA sequencing supports a snapshot of translating positions; occupancy alone does not measure elongation kinetics.

method_scopes.rationale: GTI-Seq is an explicit target in the assigned image caption and card title. At the declared family schematic scope, the drawn footprint-to-cDNA route applies to this initiation-focused ribosome profiling method. TISdb identifies its distinctive upstream preparation as LTM treatment that enriches initiating-ribosome footprints; treatment is outside the drawn route. The fixed input s1 can contain those ribosome complexes and no depicted operation imposes a conflicting inhibitor history. Assignment of the five coarse operations rests on the grouped diagram plus that footprint interface, not on proof of an identical complete library protocol from TISdb. GTI-Seq is a distinct variant, not an alias of general Ribo-Seq, and the card's harringtonine sentence is not a GTI-specific instruction.
